01 / About us

Small team.
Long horizon.

We are fourteen engineers, designers, and systems people who like the unglamorous parts of software: interfaces that stay fast, pipelines that do not break at 2 a.m., and documentation someone can actually follow.

TechNova began in 2016 with the same phone call, again and again: a product was growing faster than its foundations. We still take that call. The difference now is a decade of migrations, launches, and hard-won restraint.

  • 01 Work in the open — shared repos, weekly demos, written decisions.
  • 02 Optimize for the handover, not the invoice.
  • 03 Refuse complexity that somebody else has to carry.
